name: Warabi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Warabi city emblem in red: a ring enclosing a stylised swirl of two strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Warabi, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1959.

features.role: Warabi city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised swirl of two strokes
